items.title: Ronnie Zito interviewed by Monk Rowe & Rick Montalbano, via Zoom, March 9, 2022
items.q: And he had charts in there from Bill Holman and oh Nat Pierce did a lot, all good music, very good music.

ctx.x: Come on up to Utica and we’ll play some dang-dang-a-dang.

I’m telling you man it’s amazing. But I’ll tell you man my chops are so strange now from playing the show, I have a lot of bad habits because of the way I’m set up, things like that, and I’ve got some arthritis coming in you know. But I can still play the show, and play pretty strong yet you know. Fast — “Caldonia” is over for me. I did that with Woody for two years and “Northwest Passage” [scats] it was crazy. Woody wanted everything fast. That’s a great band leader. Woody was a great band leader. Great guy man.…
Was it “Live in Antibes” that you did?
